description: This file implements the 'BulkImportWorkbookPopulatorService' interface, providing various methods for generating Excel templates (workbooks) for bulk importing different entity types (clients, centers, groups, loans, savings, deposits, users, etc.) in a financial software system. It manages permissions, fetches necessary related data, and assembles appropriate workbook populators to produce the templates.

classes.name: BulkImportWorkbookPopulatorServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the BulkImportWorkbookPopulatorService interface, responsible for generating Excel templates for bulk import operations with permission checks and data fetching.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Main method to generate an Excel template based on entity type, with permission checks and delegating to specific populate methods.

methods.name: populateClientWorkbook
methods.description: Prepares a workbook for client data import, including permissions, data fetching, and selecting between person or entity client types.

methods.name: buildResponse
methods.description: Converts a Workbook into an HTTP Response with appropriate headers for download.

methods.name: fetchCodeValuesByCodeName
methods.description: Fetches code values by code name, throws exception if null.

methods.description: Creates a workbook for center data, including offices, staff, and groups.
